question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank 2
solution:
The correct answer is option no. (1) i.e. **'Many'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's take a look at the sentence: She was concerned that too ---------(2) parents have become convinced.
 
• **Let's see the options:**
 
 
• **Many:** used with common countable noun like many people, many boys ,many projects etc.
 
 
• **Example:-** **Many** students are absent today.
 
 
 
• **Much:** used to describe non- countable like juice, rice, happiness etc.
 
 
• **Example:** The new car is **much** better on gas mileage.
 
 
 
• **Most:** It is the superlative degree of much and used to describe the quality among the persons and things.
 
 
• **Example:** The Kanpur city is the **most** polluted cities in India. 
 
 
 
• **More: **we use more with countable or uncountable nouns when we compare two things, to say that one thing is bigger in number or amount that another thing.
 
 
• **Example: **She advised him to be **more **careful.
 
 
 
 
 
• As the word parents is a common countable noun so we use many before the word parents.
 
• Thus, we can see the other options except Many are not suitable for the blank.

So, the sentence will be- ***She was concerned that too many __parents have become convinced.***

**The correct answer is option no.(1)**
